abort_root_cause.symptom: Client aborted near ~18K visible chars during live 20K job; job kept running server-side then finished via ad-hoc continue.
abort_root_cause.false_signal: Policy keyed off cumulative Swapouts delta / memory pressure UI, not free swap.
abort_root_cause.machine_state_at_abort_note: Free swap was still healthy (~830MiB later); cumulative Swapouts always grow.
abort_root_cause.fix: should_pause_for_resources pauses only on low free swap (default <256MiB) or low Pages free (<20000). Swapouts ignored as pause trigger.

note: GPU eval paused while resources tight; MLX PID left running.
